items.title: 樂觀派也轉彎！蓋茲警告AI恐嚴重威脅人類 科技業卻刻意淡化
items.title_en: Optimists Also Turn Around! Gates Warns AI Could Pose Serious Threat to Humanity While Tech Industry Deliberately Downplays It
paras: 微軟(MSFT-US) 共同創辦人比爾蓋茲（Bill Gates）對人工智慧（AI）的態度正在出現轉變。過去一直被視為AI技術樂觀派的他，如今警告，AI有可能對人類社會構成嚴重威脅，如何應對相關風險應成為「全球頭等大事」。
蓋茲過去雖然也曾擔憂AI可能衝擊就業、助長虛假資訊，但整體仍認為相關風險基本可控，並相信AI帶來的變革前所未見，有助解決醫療資源分配不均、推動教育普及等長期困擾人類的問題。
然而，蓋茲如今對AI風險的警戒明顯升高。他接受《第一財》經專訪時表示表示，科技業其實也知道AI可能帶來的威脅，但業者往往刻意淡化相關風險，原因在於過多的風險警示可能影響融資。
AI既能縮小差距 也可能擴大不平等
蓋茲指出，從目前情況來看，AI既可以成為推動平等的強大力量，也可能進一步加劇全球既有的不平等。
他表示，如果AI只在富裕國家獲得廣泛應用，無法真正惠及開發中國家，全球不平等只會更加嚴重。以撒哈拉以南非洲為例，當地愈是缺乏醫師的地區，反而愈難充分利用AI改善醫療服務。
蓋茲認為，改變這種情況已沒有理由繼續拖延。他8月26日在個人網站發表一篇約6,000字長文時也警告，向AI時代過渡，將是人類歷史上最為動盪的時期之一，目前國際社會並未做好充分準備。
不過，蓋茲並未因此否定AI發展。他認為，只要採取適當措施，AI仍可能成為一股向善力量，讓更多人過得更好。相較於過去單純看好AI技術進步，他現在更關注的問題，是如何讓這項科技真正惠及更多人。
AI威脅警告在科技業升溫
蓋茲的警告之際，AI產業內部對技術風險的憂慮也正在浮上檯面。Anthropic研究員考克森（Jacob Coxon）9月8日在社群平台X宣布辭職，並在聲明中警告，業界領先的AI公司正競相開發「可能在未來十年內毀滅我們所有人」的超級AI技術，引發外界高度關注。
蓋茲表示，蓋茲基金會目前與微軟(MSFT-US) 、Google(GOOGL-US)、OpenAI及Anthropic等美國主要AI公司都保持良好合作關係。其中，他曾長期任職於微軟，目前仍會向公司提供部分建議；他也透露，近期將前往舊金山拜訪OpenAI與Anthropic，進行相關磋商。
今年1月，OpenAI與蓋茲基金會共同發起「地平線1000」（Horizon 1000）倡議，雙方投入5,000萬美元資金及技術支援，推動AI與醫療結合，協助非洲國家利用AI改善衛生保健體系，盧安達則成為首個試點國家。
蓋茲表示，盧安達有望在一定程度上成為非洲其他國家的樣板，當地迅速採取行動，也讓他感到振奮。
蓋茲基金會週二(15日)進一步宣布，未來兩年至少投入10億美元，推動AI更廣泛且公平地惠及全球人群。同日公布的2026年《目標守衛者報告》指出，AI最終究竟只會讓擁有最多資源的人受益，還是能真正惠及資源最匱乏的人群，目前仍未定型，因此現階段做出的選擇至關重要。
關鍵窗口只剩12至18個月
蓋茲認為，決定AI能否公平普及的關鍵窗口可能只有12至18個月，沒有時間可以浪費。
他以醫療為例表示，不論是讓AI直接協助患者、幫助醫護人員提升服務能力，或改善醫療決策品質與後續復診效果，都意味著AI有機會挽救大量生命。
不過，要讓更多人真正從AI受益，首先必須解決大型語言模型的語言落差。
早期大型語言模型訓練資料超過90%來自英語來源，因此對英語及其他主要語言使用者而言，AI能力持續變得更精準、更強大，但對許多其他語言使用者來說，進步幅度卻相當有限。
以奈及利亞為例，一名使用約魯巴語的人與目前市場領先的AI語音辨識系統對話時，錯誤率可高達60%，但同一套系統辨識英語的錯誤率不到6%。
這種落差甚至可能造成致命後果。在非洲東南部內陸國家馬拉維，如果一名產婦進入診所，以當地齊切瓦語表示「羊水破了」，現有流行AI工具可能直接翻譯成「把水倒了」，造成醫病溝通誤解。
因此，蓋茲基金會承諾投入的10億美元，部分資金將用於建立公平普惠AI所需的數位基礎設施，包括建立目前AI工具尚未充分涵蓋的語言資料集，並依據實際使用者的日常語言進行評估。
蓋茲基金會執行長Mark Suzman表示，相較於外界每天看到的AI巨額投資，10億美元或許看似不高，但在推動AI普惠的領域，這已是一筆相當可觀的投入，未來投資規模還可能進一步增加。
關注中國AI與人形機器人發展
除了AI風險與公平問題，蓋茲也高度關注中國AI產業發展。
他表示，相較其他國家，中國對人形機器人的關注程度更高，他日前還觀看世界人形機器人運動會，對比賽中既有令人驚嘆的成功，也有相當「壯觀」的失誤印象深刻。
蓋茲認為，光是舉辦「機器人奧運會」本身就具有顛覆性。由於這項技術進步速度極快，等到下一屆比賽舉行時，不論機器人的整體技術水準或比賽結果，都可能出現很大變化。
談到人形機器人的技術瓶頸，蓋茲特別點名機器人手部技術。
他表示，中國投入手部技術研究的人尤其多，自己曾在上海參觀一家研發機器人手部技術的公司，也一直密切關注相關進展。
他預測，如果再過幾年，人形機器人能達到接近人類的能力，進入建築與製造業工作，甚至可以一天24小時運作。
從生產力角度來看，這將帶來正面效果，但同時也伴隨另一個難以迴避的問題——就業。
蓋茲表示，整個社會都必須思考如何因應這項轉變，讓目前從事相關工作的人得到妥善照顧與支持，而且這種支持不能只停留在經濟層面。在他看來，這是目前全球仍未找到答案的問題。
美中AI需要合作
在蓋茲8月發表的6,000字長文中，中國共被提及三次，是除美國以外被提到最多次的國家。他在談到AI國際治理時提出，美國與中國之間需要一定程度的合作，共同因應AI帶來的挑戰。
蓋茲表示，中國AI模型目前表現非常出色。依據不同衡量方式，中國與美國分別都有四家甚至更多機構的模型處於最先進水準，得分最高的模型與其他約七個領先模型之間，實際差距並不大。
他指出，目前這些領先模型的能力，都已超過大約四個月前最好的模型，顯示AI產業技術演進速度極快。
蓋茲將目前的AI競爭局面形容為「超級競爭」。他認為，這也意味著包括非洲各國政府在內的使用者，可以取得更多性能良好、價格相對低廉的選擇。
面對AI可能帶來的全球不平等與治理問題，蓋茲進一步提出，希望美國與中國都能拿出約5%的資料中心算力，作為類似對外援助的方式，支援貧困國家，將這些運算資源投入醫療、農業與教育等具有重要人道意義的領域。
從AI技術的長期支持者，到如今將潛在風險視為「全球頭等大事」，蓋茲並未轉向反對AI，而是將焦點轉向AI快速發展背後的風險、公平與治理問題。
蓋茲認為，AI究竟會縮小全球差距，還是進一步放大既有不平等，目前仍未有定論，而未來12至18個月的選擇，可能成為決定AI發展方向的重要窗口。
paras_en: Microsoft (MSFT-US) co‑founder Bill Gates’ attitude toward artificial intelligence (AI) is shifting. Once seen as an AI optimist, he now warns that AI could pose a serious threat to human society and that addressing the related risks should become a “global top priority.”

Although Gates has previously expressed concerns that AI might disrupt jobs and fuel misinformation, he overall believed the risks were largely manageable and that AI’s unprecedented transformation would help solve long‑standing human problems such as uneven medical resource distribution and expanding education access.

However, Gates’ vigilance about AI risks has risen sharply. In an exclusive interview with First Financial, he said the tech sector knows the threats AI could bring, but companies often deliberately downplay those risks because too many warnings could affect financing.
AI can shrink gaps but also may widen inequality
Gates points out that, as things stand, AI can be a powerful force for equality but could also exacerbate existing global inequities.

He says that if AI is adopted mainly in wealthy nations and fails to reach developing countries, global inequality will only worsen. Using sub‑Saharan Africa as an example, the scarcer doctors are in a region, the harder it becomes to leverage AI to improve medical services.

Gates believes there is no longer any reason to delay changing this situation. In a roughly 6,000‑word essay posted on his personal website on August 26, he warned that the transition to an AI era will be one of the most turbulent periods in human history and that the international community is not yet adequately prepared.

Nevertheless, Gates does not reject AI development. He maintains that with appropriate measures AI can still be a force for good, improving lives for many. Compared with his earlier unqualified optimism about AI progress, he now focuses more on how to ensure the technology truly benefits a broader population.
AI Threat Warnings Heat Up in the Tech Industry

As Gates issues his warning, concerns about technical risks are surfacing within the AI industry itself. Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon announced on X on September 8 that he was resigning and warned that leading AI firms are racing to develop “super‑AI” that could “destroy all of us within the next decade,” drawing intense external attention.

Gates said the Gates Foundation currently maintains good cooperation with major U.S. AI companies including Microsoft (MSFT‑US), Google (GOOGL‑US), OpenAI and Anthropic. He has long served at Microsoft and still provides occasional advice, and he disclosed that he will soon travel to San Francisco to meet with OpenAI and Anthropic for related talks.

In January this year, OpenAI and the Gates Foundation jointly launched the “Horizon 1000” initiative, committing $50 million in funding and technical support to combine AI with healthcare and help African nations improve their health‑care systems, with Rwanda serving as the first pilot country.
Gates said Rwanda could become a model for other African countries, and the rapid local action there energizes him.

The Gates Foundation announced on Tuesday (the 15th) that it will invest at least $1 billion over the next two years to promote AI that benefits people worldwide more broadly and equitably. The same day’s 2026 “Guardians of the Goal” report noted that it is still unclear whether AI will ultimately benefit only those with the most resources or truly reach the most resource‑poor populations, making current choices crucial.
Critical Window Shrinks to 12‑18 Months
Gates believes the critical window for ensuring AI’s fair diffusion may be only 12‑18 months, with no time to waste.

He uses healthcare as an example, saying that whether AI directly assists patients, helps clinicians improve service capacity, or enhances medical decision quality and follow‑up outcomes, all mean AI has the chance to save many lives.
However, to let more people truly benefit from AI, the language gap in large‑language models must first be addressed.

Early large‑language model training data were over 90 % English‑source, so AI capabilities keep getting more precise and powerful for English and other major languages, but progress for many other language users remains limited.

Take Nigeria as an example: a Yoruba speaker interacting with today’s leading AI speech‑recognition system can experience error rates as high as 60 %, whereas the same system’s error rate for English is under 6 %.

Such gaps can even lead to fatal outcomes. In Malawi, an inland country in southeastern Africa, if a pregnant woman tells a clinic in Chichewa that “the amniotic fluid has broken,” a popular AI tool might translate it as “the water has been poured out,” causing a dangerous miscommunication between patient and provider.

Therefore, part of the $1 billion the Gates Foundation pledges will fund digital infrastructure needed for inclusive AI, including building language datasets that current AI tools do not adequately cover and evaluating them against everyday user language.

Gates Foundation CEO Mark Suzman said that, compared with the massive AI investments seen daily, $1 billion may seem modest, but in the realm of AI‑for‑inclusion it is a substantial commitment that could grow further in the future.
Watching China’s AI and Humanoid‑Robot Development
Beyond AI risk and fairness, Gates also closely follows China’s AI industry development.

He notes that, compared with other countries, China shows a higher focus on humanoid robots; he recently watched the World Humanoid Robot Games and was impressed by both the spectacular successes and the striking failures in the competition.

Gates believes that simply hosting a “Robot Olympics” is disruptive in itself. Because the technology advances so quickly, the overall technical level and competition results could look very different by the next edition of the games.
When discussing technical bottlenecks for humanoid robots, Gates singled out robot hand technology.
He says many people in China are invested in hand‑technology research; he himself visited a Shanghai company developing robotic hands and has been closely monitoring progress.
He predicts that in a few years humanoid robots could reach near‑human capabilities, work in construction and manufacturing, and even operate 24 hours a day.
From a productivity standpoint this would be positive, but it also brings an unavoidable issue—employment.

Gates says society as a whole must consider how to handle this transition, ensuring that workers currently in related jobs receive proper care and support, and that such support goes beyond purely economic measures. In his view, this remains an unanswered global question.
U.S.–China AI Cooperation Needed

In Gates’ August 6,000‑word essay, China was mentioned three times—the most of any country besides the United States. Discussing AI international governance, he argued that the U.S. and China need a degree of cooperation to jointly address AI challenges.

Gates says Chinese AI models are currently performing very well. By various metrics, both China and the United States each have four or more institutions whose models rank among the most advanced, and the top‑scoring models differ only modestly from about seven other leading models.
He notes that the capabilities of these leading models have already surpassed the best models from roughly four months ago, illustrating the rapid pace of AI industry evolution.

Gates describes the current AI competitive landscape as “hyper‑competition.” He believes this means users, including African governments, can obtain more high‑performance, relatively low‑cost options.

Facing potential global inequality and governance issues from AI, Gates further proposes that the U.S. and China each allocate roughly 5 % of their data‑center computing power as a form of external aid, directing those resources to poor nations for humanitarian‑critical fields such as health, agriculture and education.

From a long‑term AI supporter to someone now treating its potential risks as a “global top priority,” Gates has not turned against AI; instead he has shifted his focus to the risks, fairness and governance issues behind AI’s rapid development.

Gates concludes that whether AI will narrow the global gap or further widen existing inequities remains undecided, and the choices made in the next 12‑18 months could become the pivotal window that determines AI’s developmental trajectory.

items.title: Fed升息成政策錯誤？知名學者警告恐引發經濟衰退
items.title_en: Fed Rate Hike a Policy Mistake? Prominent Scholars Warn It Could Trigger a Recession
paras: 華爾街投資人與華府聯準會(Fed)觀察人士普遍預期，Fed本周召開會議時將升息，但一些知名經濟學家警告，此舉最後可能被證明是個錯誤。
他們認為，美國經濟面臨的風險可能比普遍認知更高，經濟成長恐大幅放緩。若Fed本周三(16日)升息，目標將是雙重職責之一的通膨，但這些經濟學家擔心，升息也可能導致經濟活動大幅萎縮，促使企業裁員，最終引發經濟衰退。
穆迪分析(Moody's Analytics)首席經濟學家Mark Zandi在社群平台X發文警告：「Fed犯下嚴重政策錯誤的機率高得令人不安，而且正在上升。」

恐陷負向循環

曾擔任多位民主黨領袖顧問多年的Zandi表示，在不伴隨裁員、失業率上升，以及引發「自我強化的負向循環」的情況下，很難讓經濟成長降溫。
Fed主席華許(Kevin Warsh)8月底在傑克森霍爾經濟研討會發表談話，曾釋出對通膨的擔憂，他當時表示，如果通膨情勢惡化，他將毫不遲疑採取行動。
投資人10天前還認為Fed升息的機率僅約50%。但因柴油價格上漲、中東緊張情勢再起，加上周五公布的消費者通膨報告超過市場預期，如今交易員與經濟學家相信，華許將兌現升息承諾。

經濟仍有韌性 但非毫無風險

Northern Trust首席經濟學家Carl Tannenbaum表示，升息的理由並不像市場及許多評論人士所認為的那麼明確，而且對Fed來說，沒有什麼是容易的選項。
他表示，雖然美國經濟在戰爭與關稅面前仍維保持強勁，但「並非無懈可擊」，低收入家庭必須動用儲蓄，才能跟上通膨帶來的生活成本上升。
Tannenbaum說：「維持利率不變，將提供更多時間評估經濟擴張的基礎是否存在潛在裂痕。」

升息可能為時過早

G10外匯研究全球主管Steve Englander表示，鑑於通膨數據存在多股相互牽制的力量，升息可能為時過早。
他認為，Fed正確的政策決定應是維持利率不變，直到這些相互矛盾的訊號逐漸消退。如果Fed升息後，幾個月內又被迫轉向降息，市場可能會認為華許「掌舵的手非常不穩」。
一些經濟學家則認為，市場對Fed升息的定價已經過頭。
American Enterprise Institute經濟政策研究主任Michael Strain表示，市場誤讀Fed，Fed官員之間的「重心」仍支持維持利率不變。
他表示，如果沒有能源價格上漲與關稅影響，核心通膨率將更接近2.5%，僅略高於Fed設定的2%目標。
牛津經濟研究院(Oxford Economics)首席美國經濟學家Michael Pearce表示，儘管近幾周升息的可能性確實大幅提高，但9月的政策決定仍可能朝任一方向發展。他仍維持對Fed按兵不動的預測。
paras_en: Wall Street investors and Fed watchers generally expect the Fed to raise rates at this week’s meeting, but some well‑known economists warn the move could ultimately prove to be a mistake.

They argue that the risks facing the U.S. economy may be higher than commonly perceived and growth could slow sharply. If the Fed raises rates on Wednesday the 16th, the target will be one of its dual mandates—inflation—but these economists fear a hike could also cause a major contraction in activity, spur layoffs and ultimately trigger a recession.
Moody’s Analytics chief economist Mark Zandi posted on X that “the probability that the Fed is committing a serious policy error is alarmingly high, and it’s rising.”

A Negative Feedback Loop Zandi, who has long served as an adviser to Democratic leaders, said that without layoffs, a rising unemployment rate and a self‑reinforcing negative cycle, it will be hard to cool the economy.
Fed Chair Kevin Warsh told the Jackson Hole symposium at the end of August that he was concerned about inflation and said he would act without hesitation if inflation worsened.

Investors ten days ago thought the odds of a Fed hike were only about 50%. But higher diesel prices, renewed Middle‑East tensions and a consumer‑price report on Friday that beat expectations have led traders and economists to believe Warsh will follow through on a hike.

The Economy Is Still Resilient but Not Risk‑Free Northern Trust chief economist Carl Tannenbaum said the case for a hike is not as clear‑cut as markets and many commentators think, and that there are no easy options for the Fed.

He added that while the U.S. economy remains strong despite wars and tariffs, it is “not invulnerable,” and low‑income households are forced to dip into savings to keep up with inflation‑driven cost increases.
Tannenbaum said, “Keeping rates unchanged would give more time to assess whether the foundation of economic expansion has any hidden cracks.”
A Premature Hike G10 foreign‑exchange research head Steve Englander warned that, given the mixed forces in the inflation data, a rate increase may be premature.

He believes the correct Fed policy is to hold rates steady until the contradictory signals fade. If the Fed hikes and then has to cut again within months, markets may view Warsh’s steering as “very unstable.”
Some economists think the market’s pricing of a Fed hike has gone too far.

American Enterprise Institute policy research director Michael Strain said the market misreads the Fed, noting that the “center of gravity” among Fed officials still leans toward keeping rates unchanged.
He added that without higher energy prices and tariff effects, core inflation would be closer to 2.5%, only slightly above the Fed’s 2% target.

Oxford Economics chief U.S. economist Michael Pearce said that although the odds of a hike have risen sharply in recent weeks, the September policy decision could still go either way, and he continues to forecast the Fed will hold steady.

items.title: Fed 9月升息機率近9成！美元會開啟新一輪漲勢嗎？
items.title_en: Fed's September Rate Hike Probability Near 90%—Will the Dollar Start a New Upswing?
paras: 市場對聯準會（Fed）9月升息的預期持續升溫。上週通膨數據公布後，利率期貨已大幅強化升息定價，華爾街多家機構也陸續調整預期，轉向認為9月升息幾乎已成定局。美元指數週一（14日）開盤後延續漲勢，不過，在升息預期已被市場充分反映的情況下，真正值得關注的是，聯準會升息落地後，美元是否還有進一步走強的空間。
從目前利率期貨市場定價來看，9月聯準會升息25個基點的機率已接近90%，升息幾乎成為市場共識。
不僅如此，市場目前預期，9月升息之後，本輪升息週期仍可能再升息近3次，最終政策利率將達到約4.56%的終端利率。
分析指出，9月升息本身能為美元帶來的新增利多可能相當有限，後續美元走勢關鍵，將轉向聯準會釋出的升息路徑訊號。
在升息已被充分定價的背景下，聯準會此次升息能否成為美元新一波漲勢的起點，核心將在於點陣圖對未來政策的指引，以及聯準會主席華許（Kevin Warsh）在記者會上的措辭與政策基調。
若聯準會希望推動美元指數有效突破並站穩100關卡，單純宣布升息可能仍不足夠，必須透過點陣圖釋放持續升息的訊號，讓市場相信這不是「升息一次就結束」，而是後續仍存在進一步升息的空間。
除了貨幣政策之外，美國財政狀況持續惡化，也正在成為美債殖利率與美元走勢出現分化的重要原因。
目前美國聯邦財政赤字逼近2兆美元，國債利息支出也首度突破1兆美元，長天期美債市場已開始反映債務螺旋風險。
美國財政部長貝森特正透過各項操作穩定國債市場，但與此同時，美國總統川普卻於上週提出擴張性財政方案，若共和黨持續掌控國會兩院，計畫向所有美國成年人發放5,000美元補貼。
該方案預估成本超過1.2兆美元，相當於美國GDP約4%，可能進一步放大財政赤字及國債供給壓力。
另一方面，美國財政部已針對長天期美債殖利率上升釋出維穩訊號。
美國財政部9月9日宣布回購60億美元的10年期及20年期美債，雖然規模低於市場原先預期的80億至100億美元，但若聯準會持續升息，推動10年期美債殖利率突破5%，預料財政部可能進一步擴大回購操作，以壓抑長天期債券殖利率過快上升。
這項操作被視為貝森特為長債市場提供的「看跌期權」，一定程度上替市場提供支撐。
從不同政策情境來看，9月聯準會決策對美元可能呈現明顯的不對稱風險。
若出現鴿派情境，例如9月意外不升息，或雖然升息但點陣圖中值落在4.125%以下，代表市場預期未來升息次數少於2次，可能再次引發市場對聯準會獨立性與公信力的質疑，美元指數下跌幅度可能較大。
反之，若聯準會9月升息，同時透過點陣圖釋放連續升息訊號，且點陣圖中值達到4.375%以上，代表市場預期未來仍可能升息3次以上，美元指數則可能進一步測試100點整數關卡。
至於人民幣，目前10年期中美利差已達歷史極值，從利差角度來看，並不利於人民幣持續升值。
不過，中國高額貿易順差仍持續支撐企業結匯需求。在利差與企業結匯兩股力量交互作用下，USDCNY預料可能在6.70附近維持一段時間的震盪整理。
paras_en: The market's expectation of a Fed rate hike in September continues to heat up. After last week's inflation data release, rate futures have sharply increased their pricing for a hike, and several Wall Street institutions have adjusted their forecasts, now viewing a September hike as almost a certainty. The dollar index continued its rise after the Monday (the 14th) open, but with the hike already fully priced in, the real question is whether the dollar can still strengthen further once the Fed actually raises rates.
Based on current pricing in the rate futures market, the probability of a 25‑basis‑point Fed hike in September is now close to 90%, making the hike almost a market consensus.
Moreover, the market now expects that after the September hike, this tightening cycle could see roughly three more hikes, bringing the terminal policy rate to about 4.56%.

Analysts note that the direct boost a September hike can give the dollar may be quite limited; the key to the dollar’s subsequent trajectory will shift to the Fed’s signals about the path of future hikes.

With the hike already fully priced, whether this move can become the starting point of a new wave of dollar strength hinges on the dot‑plot’s guidance for future policy and the wording and tone of Fed Chair Kevin Warsh at the press conference.

If the Fed wants the dollar index to break and stay above the 100‑point threshold, simply announcing a hike may not be enough; it must use the dot‑plot to signal continued tightening, convincing the market that this is not a one‑off move but that further hikes are still on the table.
Beyond monetary policy, the deteriorating U.S. fiscal situation is becoming a major factor behind the divergence between Treasury yields and the dollar’s direction.

The U.S. federal deficit is now approaching $2 trillion, and interest payments on the debt have for the first time exceeded $1 trillion, prompting the long‑term Treasury market to price in debt‑spiral risks.

Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen is taking actions to stabilize the bond market, while President Trump last week proposed an expansionary fiscal plan that, if Republicans retain control of both chambers, would grant every American adult a $5,000 subsidy.
The plan is estimated to cost over $1.2 trillion—about 4% of U.S. GDP—and could further widen the fiscal deficit and increase pressure on Treasury supply.
On the other hand, the Treasury has signaled its intent to keep long‑term yields in check.

On September 9, the Treasury announced a $6 billion buy‑back of 10‑year and 20‑year Treasuries—smaller than the market’s $8‑$10 billion expectation—but if the Fed keeps tightening and 10‑year yields push past 5%, the Treasury may expand repurchases to curb a rapid rise in long‑term yields.
This operation is seen as Yellen providing the long‑bond market with a “put option,” offering some support to the market.
Considering different policy scenarios, the Fed’s September decision could pose a markedly asymmetric risk to the dollar.

In a dovish scenario—say, an unexpected pause in September or a hike with a dot‑plot median below 4.125%—the market would infer fewer than two more hikes, potentially sparking doubts about the Fed’s independence and credibility and leading to a larger drop in the dollar index.

Conversely, if the Fed hikes in September and uses the dot‑plot to signal continued tightening with a median at or above 4.375%, the market would expect three or more additional hikes, and the dollar index could test the 100‑point round number.
As for the renminbi, the 10‑year U.S.–China yield spread has reached a historic high, which from a spread perspective does not favor further RMB appreciation.

Nevertheless, China’s large trade surplus continues to support corporate demand for foreign‑exchange settlement. The interaction of the yield spread and corporate settlement demand suggests the USDCNY could hover around 6.70 for a period, trading in a range‑bound consolidation.

items.title: 不到十個月擬3度升息！日央行料創1990年來最快升速　日債、美債與經濟復甦迎來考驗
items.title_en: Three Rate Hikes in Under Ten Months Planned! BoJ Expected to Set Fastest Pace Since 1990, Japanese and U.S. Bonds and Economic Recovery Face Tests
paras: 在美國財長貝森特連番施壓、日元偏軟與物價續漲下，日本央行(BOJ)本周五(18日)料將升息1碼，若成真將是不到10個月三度升息，創1990年來最快升息速度。
1990年，日本一年四度大幅升息重創東證一部指數，揭開長期停滯序幕，而當前日本經濟溫和，風險則集中於匯市與債市。
眼下，市場主要有兩大擔憂；一是日元反彈不力恐推高美債殖利率，墊升美國企業與消費借貸成本；二則是日本國債殖利率急漲則震盪全球，並讓日本首相高市早苗2.4兆美元投資計畫融資更難。高市欲藉該計畫重新帶動經濟成長，若籌資成本失控恐適得其反。
英國資產管理公司Marlborough駐倫敦經理James Athey說，基金仍押日元走強，但資金一有風吹草動便可能再砍倉。他並認為，BOJ必須升息並釋放更鷹指引，否則前期干預成果盡失，市場將聚焦BOJ總裁植田和男記者會。
日元自7月底日本干預以來升值近6%，美國28年來首度協防，單月耗資15.4兆日元、約千億美元。若BOJ周五不升息，既悖離貝森特立場，也打擊已反映續加的市場。貝森特直言干預前已掌握BOJ動向，暗示美日協調。若日元再貶值恐逼日本賣美債，殖利率上行將衝擊美國11月期中大選，有序升息則可延續反彈、促成通膨達標以及穩定債券殖利率。
paras_en: Under pressure from U.S. Treasury Secretary Yellen, a soft yen and continuing price rises, the Bank of Japan (BoJ) is expected to raise rates by one basis point this Friday (the 18th). If it happens, it will be the third hike in less than ten months, marking the fastest tightening pace since 1990.

In 1990 Japan raised rates sharply four times in a year, which devastated the TOPIX and ushered in a long period of stagnation. Today Japan’s economy is only modestly expanding, with risks now concentrated in the foreign‑exchange and bond markets.

Currently the market has two main worries: first, a weak rebound in the yen could push U.S. Treasury yields higher, raising borrowing costs for American firms and consumers; second, a rapid surge in Japanese government bond yields could rattle global markets and make it harder to finance Prime Minister Kishida’s $2.4 trillion investment plan. Kishida hopes the plan will reignite growth, but if financing costs spiral out of control it could backfire.

James Athey, London manager for UK asset‑manager Marlborough, said funds are still betting on a stronger yen, but any market jitters could trigger further position cuts. He added that the BoJ must raise rates and adopt a more hawkish forward guidance, or else the gains from earlier interventions will be lost and attention will shift to BoJ Governor Ueda’s press conference.

Since the end‑July intervention, the yen has appreciated about 6%, while the United States has, for the first time in 28 years, coordinated a defensive effort, spending roughly ¥15.4 trillion (about $1 billion) in a single month. If the BoJ does not hike on Friday, it would contradict Yellen’s stance and undermine a market that has already priced in further tightening. Yellen has said she knew the BoJ’s direction before the intervention, hinting at U.S.–Japan coordination. A further yen decline could force Japan to sell U.S. Treasuries, pushing yields up and affecting the U.S. November midterm elections, whereas a orderly hike could sustain the yen’s rebound, help meet inflation targets and keep bond yields stable.

items.title: 【遠東商銀】油價大漲添憂慮，湧入美元避險
items.title_en: Far East Commercial Bank: Oil Price Surge Adds Concern, Inflows into Dollar Safe Haven
paras: ◆USD/JPY

美國8月消費者物價加速上漲，加大市場對美國聯邦準備理事會(FED)升息的押注，並據芝加哥商業交易所(CME)的FedWatch工具顯示，FED本周會議加息25個基點的機率約90%，更預期今年稍晚再升息一次，提供美元支撐，但美國商品期貨交易委員會(CFTC)數據顯示投機客自2月以來首次轉為日圓淨多倉，並據日本內閣官房長官木原稔表示編製預算時將適當控制發行公債規模，而且日本央行(BOJ)會議紀錄援引理事中村康治於5月貨幣政策會議的說法稱，日本通貨膨脹率因進口成本上升和匯率波動飆升，表明制定貨幣政策時要對此類非線性通貨膨脹保持警戒，激勵日圓上漲，美元兌日圓下滑至153.29低點。

隨著日本7月經季節調整工業產出修正意外跌0.2%及產能利用指數降至0.5%，令日圓承壓，而且沙烏地阿拉伯遭新一輪襲擊及荷姆茲海峽航運受阻，海灣國家則推遲與伊朗的會晤及解決衝突的外交斡旋陷入僵局，加劇石油供應的擔憂，推動油價大漲，並據前沿科技公司首席執行官對人工智能(AI)潛在風險發出警告衝擊股市，增添避險情緒，推升美元兌日圓至154.99高點。預估今日美元兌日圓支撐於154.00-20，阻力於155.00-20。
◆EUR/USD
昨日紐西蘭公布8月企業服務業表現指數(PSI)升至50.8，但海灣地區新供應中斷推動油價飆升，強化市場對全球進一步收緊貨幣政策的預期，打擊風險偏好，削弱澳幣和紐元，並據德國經濟部月度報告表示，能源密集型產業的繁榮勢頭減弱及能源價格上漲，導致消費疲軟，德國經濟第三季初增長勢頭放緩，拖累歐元兌美元自1.1599高點下跌。

據歐洲央行(ECB)管理委員會委員卡薩克斯稱，ECB進一步收緊貨幣政策的理由越來越充分，另一位委員卡日米爾則表示關注天然氣價格，認為通貨膨脹存在上行風險，而且ECB執行委員會委員施納貝爾擔憂中東衝突引發的近期能源價格走勢，但中東衝突持續推高油價，投資人買入美元避險，而且市場聚焦FED本周的利率決議支撐美元，打壓歐元兌美元至1.1522低點。預估今日歐元兌美元阻力於1.1545-65，支撐於1.1460-80。
◆GBP/USD

paras: 美元對主要貨幣周一(14日)多上揚，中東衝突刺激油價上漲，促使投資人湧向美元避險，並提高了聯準會(Fed)本周升息的可能性，都助長美元升勢。

In late New York trading, the ICE Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the dollar against six major currencies, rose 0.3% to around 99.41, touching 99.735 intraday, the highest since September 2.
The euro fell to a one-month low of $1.153, while the pound also declined 0.2% to $1.3512.

The oil price spike unsettled investors and pushed global bond yields back near multi-year highs. Brent crude at one point surged 5% to $109.80 a barrel before paring gains to close at $105.61 a barrel.

Oil prices have been supported by multiple forces in recent days, the most significant being attacks by the Iran-backed Houthi group on Saudi Arabia, the world's largest oil exporter. Saudi Arabia had previously shut down a major pipeline used to bypass the Strait of Hormuz and reach the Red Sea, and now the Red Sea is also under threat from the Houthis.

Diplomatic mediation in the US-Iran conflict appears to have stalled, with the current meeting between Iran and other Gulf states postponed, and attacks on vessels in the Middle East have further intensified market concerns over oil supply.

ING FX strategist Francesco Pesole said: 'The Gulf situation remains concerning, and some AI-related news has further weighed on equities. In this environment, the dollar should continue to find support.'

The market is growing increasingly confident that the Fed will hike rates this Wednesday in response to the energy price spike. Rising energy prices have already pushed diesel prices to record highs and caused August core inflation to come in above expectations.
Data from CME Group's FedWatch tool shows traders are pricing in roughly a 90% probability of a Fed rate hike, up from about 60% a week earlier.

Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG) senior FX analyst Lee Hardman said: 'The dollar has firmed modestly early this week, buoyed by rising market expectations that the Fed will begin tightening monetary policy.'
However, the dollar's recent strength is not without risks.

A team led by Scotiabank analyst Shaun Osborne noted in a report: 'If the Fed holds rates steady, it would surprise the market and be clearly negative for the dollar. But a "dovish hike" without a clear commitment to further tightening could also put pressure on the dollar.'
Yen Weakens; Dollar Reclaims 154 Yen
The yen weakened noticeably, with its recent strong rally driven by market bets on a Bank of Japan (BOJ) rate hike showing signs of fading.
The dollar-yen pair rose 0.5% to 154.355, moving away from below 153, a near-seven-month low touched last week.

Heating global rate-hike expectations have pushed US, European, and Japanese bond yields to multi-year or even multi-decade highs. However, the impact on the FX market has been relatively limited so far, as yields across major markets have risen roughly in tandem.
The market is nearly certain the BOJ will hike rates on Friday. Yen market sentiment has also begun to shift, with speculators turning net long the yen for the first time since February.

The Bank of England (BOE) is expected to hold rates steady on Thursday, but traders now anticipate a hike later this year and further tightening in 2027. The European Central Bank (ECB) hiked rates last week.

items.title: 日央行高層警惕「非線性」通膨衝擊 預期本周將再度升息
items.title_en: Bank of Japan Officials Warn of “Non‑Linear” Inflation Shock, Expect Another Rate Hike This Week
paras: 根據周一(14日)公布的會議紀錄顯示，一位日本央行官員指出，受進口成本上升和匯率波動衝擊影響，日本通膨率急劇攀升，這顯示在貨幣政策決策時，必須將此類價格波動因素納入考量。
上述言論出自日本央行5月主辦的貨幣政策會議。日本央行已於6月將政策利率調升至 1% 的31年新高，並預計在本周再度升息，以因應日益嚴峻的通膨壓力。
央行通常透過升息來抑制需求驅動型通膨。然而，新冠疫情、俄羅斯入侵烏克蘭、美國提高關稅以及中東衝突等事件，使得人們的焦點轉向了供給側通膨。
負責貨幣政策企畫的日央行執行董事中村康治(Koji Nakamura)在會議中指出，日本國內物價對外部衝擊出現了「非線性」反應，消費者物價對進口價格與匯率波動呈現劇烈上揚。他強調，雖然傳統做法是無視供給面衝擊，但若外部衝擊頻繁發生，就不應將其視為暫時現象，因為這會持續推升基底通膨與民眾的通膨預期。
此外，中村表示，日本同時面臨勞動力減少帶動工資上漲的「慢速人口結構衝擊」，此為不可忽視的結構性因素。
自2024年結束長達十年的超寬鬆刺激計畫以來，日央行已承諾將持續升息。當前緊繃的就業市場、日元疲軟導致的進口成本增加，以及中東衝突引發的燃料價格上漲，均加劇了通膨超越 2% 目標的風險。央行未來需將數據分析與實地調查相結合，以更精準掌握企業與家庭行為的改變對通膨預期的影響。
paras_en: According to the minutes released on Monday (the 14th), a Bank of Japan official said that rising import costs and exchange‑rate volatility have caused Japan’s inflation rate to surge sharply, indicating that such price‑fluctuation factors must be taken into account when making monetary‑policy decisions.

The remarks were made at the Bank of Japan’s May monetary‑policy meeting. The BOJ raised its policy rate to 1% in June – a 31‑year high – and expects to hike again this week to cope with mounting inflation pressure.

Central banks usually raise rates to curb demand‑driven inflation. However, events such as the COVID‑19 pandemic, Russia’s invasion of Ukraine, higher U.S. tariffs and Middle‑East conflicts have shifted attention toward supply‑side inflation.

Koji Nakamura, an executive director in charge of monetary‑policy planning, said in the meeting that domestic prices in Japan are reacting “non‑linearly” to external shocks, with consumer prices spiking sharply as import prices and exchange rates fluctuate. He stressed that while the traditional approach is to ignore supply‑side shocks, frequent external shocks should not be treated as temporary, as they will keep pushing up core inflation and inflation expectations.
Nakamura also noted that Japan is simultaneously facing a “slow‑moving demographic shock” – a shrinking labor force that is driving wage growth – which is a structural factor that cannot be ignored.

Since ending a decade‑long ultra‑easy stimulus program at the end of 2024, the BOJ has pledged to keep raising rates. A tight labour market, a weak yen that raises import costs, and higher fuel prices from Middle‑East conflicts all heighten the risk of inflation exceeding the 2% target. The bank will need to combine data analysis with on‑the‑ground surveys to more accurately gauge how changes in corporate and household behaviour affect inflation expectations.

items.title_en: Fed Rate‑Hike Expectations Heat Up, Boosting the Dollar; Asian Currencies Mostly Weaker, Yen Holds Near 7‑Month High
paras: 受市場對美國聯準會本周升息預期大幅上升影響，美元強勢走高，亞洲貨幣周一(14日)普遍對美元走弱。然而，由於市場押注日本銀行(BOJ)將加速緊縮貨幣政策，日元表現相對堅挺，維持在接近7個月的高位附近。
在美國8月消費者物價指數(CPI)加速上漲後，根據 CME FedWatch 工具顯示，市場目前預估聯準會在9月16日會議升息的機率已升至 86%。升息預期的劇增帶動美元指數上漲0.2%至99.35附近，結束了連續兩周的微幅下跌。
美債殖利率同步受到支撐，10年期美債殖利率來到約4.97%，而對政策利率極為敏感的2年期美債殖利率則保持在4.6%以上。
本周全球金融市場迎來關鍵的「超級央行周」，聯準會、英國央行與日本央行將接連公布最新利率決策。市場目前已幾乎完全消化日本銀行周五將升息25個基點(0.25%)的預期，加上投資人預計日本海外資產可能回流，帶動日元本月累積上漲約 4%。
目前美元對日元交投於154.03附近，維持在接近上周創下的2月以來最高點152.89附近，投機客自2月以來首次轉為淨多頭。
在其他主要貨幣方面，歐元對美元下跌0.3%至1.1564，英鎊對美元下跌0.2%至1.3501。亞幣與周邊貨幣普遍承壓，美元對澳元上漲0.4%、對韓元上漲0.25%、對新加坡元上漲0.16%，紐元對美元則下跌0.5%。人民幣表現相對平穩，美元對離岸人民幣微升0.01%至6.7080，印度市場則因國定假日休市。
此外，中東地區的新衝突引發供應疑慮，布蘭特原油期貨大漲近3%至每桶107.60美元。油價持續穩居100美元上方，恐使能源通膨居高不下，進一步增添各國央行在制定利率政策時的複雜度與考驗。
paras_en: The dollar surged as market expectations for a Federal Reserve rate hike this week rose sharply, causing Asian currencies to generally weaken against the dollar on Monday (the 14th). However, because markets are betting that the Bank of Japan will accelerate its monetary tightening, the yen remained relatively firm, staying near a seven‑month high.

After the U.S. August consumer price index (CPI) accelerated, the CME FedWatch tool showed that the market now estimates an 86% probability that the Fed will raise rates at its September 16 meeting. The surge in rate‑hike expectations lifted the dollar index by 0.2% to around 99.35, ending two weeks of modest declines.
U.S. Treasury yields were supported as well, with the 10‑year yield around 4.97% and the policy‑sensitive 2‑year yield staying above 4.6%.

This week marks a pivotal “super central‑bank week” as the Fed, the Bank of England and the Bank of Japan are set to announce their latest rate decisions. The market has almost fully priced in the BOJ’s expected 25‑basis‑point (0.25%) hike on Friday, and investors anticipate possible repatriation of Japanese overseas assets, driving the yen up about 4% cumulatively this month.
The dollar‑yen pair is trading near 154.03, close to the February‑to‑present peak of 152.89 set last week, with speculators turning net long on the yen for the first time since February.

Among other major currencies, the euro fell 0.3% to $1.1564 and the pound slipped 0.2% to $1.3501. Asian and regional currencies were broadly under pressure: the dollar rose 0.4% against the Australian dollar, 0.25% against the Korean won, and 0.16% against the Singapore dollar, while the New Zealand dollar fell 0.5% versus the dollar. The renminbi was relatively stable, with the offshore yuan edging up 0.01% to 6.7080, and Indian markets were closed for a public holiday.

A new conflict in the Middle East sparked supply concerns, sending Brent crude futures up nearly 3% to $107.60 a barrel. Oil prices staying above $100 a barrel could keep energy‑related inflation high, adding further complexity and challenges for central banks as they set interest‑rate policy.

items.title: 金磚峰會與南方六國首度接入CIPS 人民幣國際支付再擴容
items.title_en: BRICS Summit and Six Southern Nations Join CIPS for the First Time, Expanding RMB International Payments
paras: 2026年9月，全球跨境支付體系出現新動態。第十八屆金磚國家峰會於新德里落幕，會議明確提出深化金磚國家（BRICS）跨境支付合作，推動成員國本土支付系統互聯互通並擴大本幣結算規模。同時，在廈門舉行的第二屆 CIPS 跨境銀企合作活動中，盧安達、土耳其、烏茲別克、馬爾地夫、馬來西亞及喬治亞等六國金融機構首次接入人民幣跨境支付系統（CIPS）。
根據活動數據，期間共有 11 家外資銀行簽署成為 CIPS 直接參與者，4 家境外銀行與 14 家境內銀行完成直參上線。
截至目前，CIPS 參與者已覆蓋全球 133 個國家與地區，服務約 192 個國家和地區的 5,300 家法人銀行，近期單日交易額突破 1.22 兆元人民幣。此外，星展銀行（新加坡）作為首家直連的新加坡銀行，試運行以來累計處理 240 億元人民幣支付；渣打香港則完成了 CIPS 與網聯清算系統的對接，整合跨境與零售支付。
中國國家金融與發展實驗室理事楊濤指出，加強支付合作可降低對美元及西方主導之 SWIFT 體系的依賴，強化金融自主性與抗制裁韌性。他分析，最切合實際的路徑是由雙邊合作逐步擴展至多邊機制。
上海金融研究院副院長劉曉春表示，經由美國清算銀行及 CHIPS 系統進行的美元清算，均處於美國監管視角下。他認為，相較於重新建構獨立的訊息傳遞網路，擴建現有的 CIPS 系統更具可行性。此外，劉曉春評估，在當前各國經濟差異下，推動統一的金磚貨幣並不現實。
中金公司首席經濟學家苗延亮指出，數位人民幣（e-CNY）的可程式化特性有利於大額跨境結算。多邊央行數位貨幣平台 mBridge 截至 2025 年底累計交易額已近 5,000 億元人民幣，其中逾 95% 採用數位人民幣
。然而，苗延亮也提醒，跨管轄區的技術標準與合規體系互通性仍是主要挑戰。
楊濤表示，各國金融體系差異、反洗錢與打擊資恐（AML/CFT）規範不同，以及地緣政治因素，均可能放緩合作落地步調。
劉曉春強調，推動支付合作的關鍵在於尊重市場與商業偏好，而非透過行政手段指定特定貨幣或系統，以利促進區域經貿發展。
paras_en: In September 2026, a new development emerged in the global cross‑border payment system. The 18th BRICS summit concluded in New Delhi, explicitly calling for deeper cross‑border payment cooperation among BRICS members, promoting interconnection of domestic payment systems and expanding settlement in local currencies. At the same time, during the second CIPS cross‑border bank‑enterprise cooperation event in Xiamen, financial institutions from six countries—Rwanda, Turkey, Uzbekistan, the Maldives, Malaysia and Georgia—connected to the People’s Republic of China’s cross‑border payment system (CIPS) for the first time.
According to the event data, a total of 11 foreign‑owned banks signed up to become direct participants in CIPS, while 4 overseas banks and 14 domestic banks completed direct‑participation onboarding.

To date, CIPS participants cover 133 countries and regions worldwide, serving about 5,300 corporate banks in roughly 192 countries and regions. Recent single‑day transaction volume has surpassed RMB 1.22 trillion. Moreover, DBS Bank (Singapore), the first Singapore bank with direct connectivity, has processed RMB 240 billion in payments since its trial launch, and Standard Chartered Hong Kong has completed integration of CIPS with the domestic clearing system, linking cross‑border and retail payments.

Yang Tao, director of China’s National Financial and Development Laboratory, noted that strengthening payment cooperation can reduce reliance on the US‑dominated SWIFT system and the dollar, enhancing financial autonomy and resilience against sanctions. He argued that the most practical path is to expand from bilateral cooperation to multilateral mechanisms.

Liu Xiaochun, vice president of the Shanghai Institute of Financial Research, pointed out that dollar clearing through the US clearing bank and the CHIPS system is subject to US regulatory oversight. He believes that expanding the existing CIPS network is more feasible than building an independent messaging network from scratch, and he assesses that, given current economic disparities, a unified BRICS currency is unrealistic.

Miao Yanliang, chief economist at CICC, highlighted that the programmable nature of the digital yuan (e‑CNY) is advantageous for large‑scale cross‑border settlements. The multilateral central‑bank digital currency platform mBridge has accumulated nearly RMB 500 billion in transaction volume by the end of 2025, with over 95% of that volume using digital yuan.
However, Miao also warned that technical standards and regulatory interoperability across jurisdictions remain major challenges.
Yang Tao added that differences in national financial systems, varying AML/CFT regulations, and geopolitical factors could all slow the pace of cooperation implementation.

Liu Xiaochun emphasized that the key to advancing payment cooperation is respecting market and commercial preferences rather than imposing specific currencies or systems through administrative means, thereby fostering regional trade and economic development.
